title: Introduction to Data Visualization with ggplot2

modules.title: Understanding the Grammar of Graphics
modules.description: Introduce the foundational concepts of ggplot2's grammar of graphics framework.

lessons.title: Grammar of Graphics Basics
objectives: Understand the core components of ggplot2 (data, aesthetics, geometry)

modules.title: Creating Common Visualizations
modules.description: Learn to generate scatter plots, bar charts, and other common plot types using ggplot2.

lessons.title: Scatter Plots and Bar Charts
objectives: Create scatter plots and bar charts with ggplot2

modules.title: Customizing Aesthetics and Themes
modules.description: Explore customization options for plot appearance, including colors, labels, and themes.

lessons.title: Aesthetic and Theme Customization
objectives: Modify plot aesthetics and apply custom themes

modules.title: Troubleshooting and Interpretation
modules.description: Address common visualization issues and interpret plot outputs effectively.

lessons.title: Debugging and Interpretation
objectives: Interpret and troubleshoot common visualization errors

learning_objectives: Understand the grammar of graphics framework in ggplot2
Create common visualization types (scatter plots, bar charts, etc.)
Interpret and troubleshoot common visualization issues
assumptions: Participants have R installed and basic data analysis experience
Familiarity with tidyverse data structures (data frames)
